title: Ice Spice
description: Ice Spice chases you (SCARY) she will get you
body:
# Ice Spice Mod (Forge 1.20.1)

## Overview
The **Ice Spice Mod** brings a new nighttime entity.

## Features
- **Nighttime Spawning**
  - Ice Spice has a chance to spawn naturally during the night.
  - Spawn rates at 25% every 2 mins (will be adding config file).

- **Dance to Survive**
  - The only way to stop her attack is to *dance*.
  - In-game, this means **spamming crouch**.
  - If performed correctly, she will stop chasing and leave you alone.

## Compatibility
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1  
- **Mod Loader:** Forge  

## ToDo
- Improve sound effects
- Configurable spawn rates
- Additional animations
